bounds: evidence/n3-vulkan-compute-bounds.json (committed 96e8fe1 before any pass ran on Vulkan)
ci: GitHub Actions job vulkan-linux on PR #165, ubuntu-24.04, lavapipe (llvmpipe, LLVM 20.1.2, Mesa 25.2.8), Khronos validation layer on. Records: evidence/n3-lavapipe-compute/*.json. The same commands in WSL Ubuntu 24.04 with the same Mesa gave byte-identical identity outputs (90 files).

c2_golden_per_device_class.result: the quick matrix of this run is committed as evidence/n3-identity-golden-vulkan-lavapipe.json; CI compares every later run with it, byte for byte (arena_certificate.json left out, as for the CPU golden). Two local runs and this CI run were identical. CPU outputs were not re-compared in this job; the backend does not touch the CPU path, and the build-test job keeps the CPU golden.
c2_golden_per_device_class.prediction: held for the GPU golden; the CPU half of the bound was not run here (recorded)

c2_m2_m3_corpora.result: texture-identity, pbr-parity, swr-render (6 of 6 frames bit-exact), swr-parity, rt-bvh-parity, rt-pt-parity (gate), rt-hybrid-parity, sdf-parity (gate, the Mandelbulb within), post-parity (gate; TAA passes, a recorded failure on WARP) and raster-identity through WARP's gate (raw-hall nave G-buffer the same recorded open failure; 8 subpixel bits) all pass.
misses: lighting-parity: shading worst ratio 1.095 to its bound, 3 of 4,096 samples outside; clusters and prefilter pass. SwiftShader passes the same check (0.374). Recorded, not gated in the vulkan-linux job.

shadow-parity map identity: lookups, contact shadows and all controls pass, but raw-hero (worst depth 2.3e-5, one texel of cascade 2 unexplained) and raw-hall nave (worst depth 1.4e-4) exceed the 1e-5 map bound that --gate-maps applies on WARP. On lavapipe the map identity is recorded and not gated, as for SwiftShader.
c2_m2_m3_corpora.prediction: missed for lighting and the shadow-map identity; held for every other gate

c3_style_passes.result: pass: style-parity GPU on lavapipe against the C++ float64 reference within the ADR 0019 bounds

control.result: pass: with RAW_NATIVE_SPIRV_CONTROL=swap, 1 of 4 certificates verified (nort-256, which has no ray-traced AO); the 3 others refuted

finding: Without NoContraction, lavapipe fused multiply-adds: the software rasterizer differed from its CPU reference on 3 of 6 frames (134, 61 and 5 pixels) and the Mandelbulb march was outside its bound. The backend now decorates every float add, subtract, multiply and dot product NoContraction before vkCreateShaderModule (src/rhi/vulkan/vk_rhi_spirv.cpp), the SPIR-V side of dxc -Gis; then all 6 frames are bit-exact and the Mandelbulb is within.
local_swiftshader: Windows, SwiftShader (Chromium's copy), offscreen: --gpu verified, quick identity 4 of 4, texture, PBR and lighting parity pass, the swap control refutes. Its 4 subpixel bits fail the G-buffer comparisons (known). post-parity crashed with an access violation; which pass triggers it is unknown; lavapipe runs it cleanly.
does_not_prove: Behaviour on hardware Vulkan drivers or a Steam Deck; timings; that the shadow-map and lighting misses are driver precision rather than a backend fault (the evidence points to precision: every differing texel but one is an explained tie, and SwiftShader passes the lighting check).
